text:
Alex K: Heads-up: planning a staggered NIC firmware + rack BMC reboot in az3 to mitigate packet loss we saw last week. Target window: Tue 02:00-06:00 UTC. We'll do cohorted node drains + GPU reboots. Tentative cohorts of 8-12 nodes, 15m per cohort, canary first. Details follow.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: MW-az3-nic-bmc-1769998888. Notifying affected services.
Priya S: How much spare capacity do we need? any expected burst to preemptible/spot?
Marco T: Plan: keep 25% spare GPU capacity in az3. We'll backfill with other regions for non-data-local requests. Canary = nodes 101-102, then cohorts 103-110, 111-122, etc.
Marco T: Drain command we'll run (example):
```
./clusterctl drain --cohort cohortA --nodes node[103-110] --preflight-checks --grace 300
```
Sofia L: Also recommend pre-warming KV cache after each cohort completes — otherwise we see 2-4x latency spikes on first few requests.
Sofia L: Quick warmup script (run from ops):
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"warm"}' >/dev/null; done
```
Priya S: If we route prod traffic cross-region for some tenants, should we enable model-fallback to smaller variants to limit token cost?
Alex K: Yes — enable routing policy: prefer regional, fallback to cross-region small-quantized models. Cost hit estimate: ~$3k-4k for the window if 30% of requests go cross-region; will refine in ticket.
Marco T: We'll stagger NIC updates per top-of-rack to avoid egress chokepoints. Network team will monitor BGP and egress QOS. @pagerduty-bot will page if packet loss >0.5% sustained.
pagerduty-bot: Alert rule added: az3-nic-fw-packetloss. Threshold: 0.5% for 5m.
Priya S: Any customer-facing risk? CS/Support needs a short blurb.
Sofia L: Low risk for most customers; recommend email to high-SLA tenants + dashboard banner. I can draft the blurb.
Alex K: Action items:
- Marco: run canary and report at +30m after canary completion
- Sofia: draft CS blurb + dashboard banner
- Priya: confirm backup capacity with finance for spot spend
- Alex: create maintenance ticket + update console rollout page
Everyone: reply with :thumbsup: when you accept.
Priya S: :thumbsup:
Marco T: :thumbsup:
Sofia L: :thumbsup:
Alex K: Thanks all — will lock in timeline after canary sign-off.
